column1: # One question, one home: the answers that are written in more than one place.
# Q <tab> id <tab> the question <tab> its home (the one file that should answer it) <tab> the mark of a copy (a regular
#   expression, matched against code without comments and strings) <tab> what to do instead of writing a copy
# C <tab> id <tab> a file other than the home where the mark is found today <tab> how many times <tab> debt | other <tab> note
# S <tab> a salt that more than one per-unit trait is drawn with <tab> how many traits
# debt: a copy that has to go. other: the same mark, a different question.
# A unit's trait is drawn from its key mixed with a salt: two traits on one salt are one draw, not two.
# The check fails when the code and these rows differ, in either direction: a new copy needs no row, it needs the
# home; a copy that was removed takes its row with it.
